detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same 40-year-old broad-shouldered Chinese man throughout, same face, same uneven full beard, same open khaki work shirt over a grey vest with a dark towel around his neck. The camera holds a static shot. His right hand wipes once down the seam of his trousers, his shoulders draw in a little, and only after that do his lips part; when the question ends his eyes stay aimed off to the left of frame, waiting. The speaker (S1) says, asks in Mandarin Chinese, slowing down, the pitch sinking at the end as if testing the ground, <d>[Chinese] 那咱，还回万通矿业吗？</d> wind only, the score cuts out. [Shot 2] At 00:04.042, the camera cuts to the framing eases from a close-up into a tight close-up. The camera stands on the red-dirt road outside the prison gate at eye level, about 1.5 metres up, facing the rusted iron gate straight on. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. His head turns a few degrees left and back once in a single small shake, then settles; as the last two words leave him his chin lifts another few degrees and holds there, and his eyelids stay open and still. The speaker (S2) says, quiet and completely settled, each syllable placed, <d>[Chinese] 不回了，自己干。</d> the ambient is pulled away for half a second, then one low drum hit lands.
